name: Yavaş İşlem Hızı
definition: Bilgiyi al → anla → karar ver → hareket döngüsünün canlı ortamda normalden uzun sürmesi. Zeka düşük değil; zamanlama sorunu.

mechanisms.primary: Processing speed bottleneck in working memory pipeline
mechanisms.note: NOT intelligence — separate construct from IQ
secondary: Social scene moves too quickly to process (verbal + nonverbal)
WM capacity limits under time pressure
May co-occur with ADHD, autism, anxiety — but exists independently

research_sources.finding: Slow processing speed: doesn't listen, can't follow directions, overwhelmed by verbal info, needs more time to answer, hesitant even when knows answer.
Speed-of-processing training: 10 hours, 9.8-14.9 percentage point improvement >0.5 SD. UFOV-based.
Visual speed of processing training: small-medium effects on UFOV. On-site + booster best. 3-4 years protection against age decline.
SOPT improves trained task (UFOV) but NO near/far transfer to neuropsychological measures. Transfer limited.
COMPENSATORY approach superior to restoration. TPM: prevent/manage time pressure rather than speed up brain. Significant real-world task speed improvement at 3 months.
TPM > concentration training for head injury. Greater gains, generalizes to speed and memory measures.
Commercial cognitive games: g=0.40 processing speed in older adults. Working memory g=0.21, executive g=0.21.
TPM = Practice Standard for attention/processing speed after TBI. Metacognitive strategy training for generalization.
Compensatory strategies + cognitive exercise + strategy coaching improves work outcomes. Chunking, planning, coping strategies.
Computer-based training: NO effect on processing speed in ABI. Compensatory TPM more suited.
TPM based on Michon: transfer actions from high time pressure to low time pressure situations where preserved decision levels work.
Game-supported TPM: 5-step strategy for everyday activities. Identify time pressure → compensate via prevention/reduction strategies.
WMC predicts faster tactical decisions at ALL expertise levels. Deliberate practice + WMC = independent contributions.
Slow processors: methodical analysis, deep thinking, reduced impulsivity as advantages. Design environment, don't white-knuckle speed.

solutions.name: Time Pressure Management (TPM)
solutions.protocol: 5 adım: (1) Zaman baskısını fark et (2) Önle (hazırlık) (3) Yönet (yedek strateji) (4) Görevi parçala (5) Performansı izle

solutions.name: Ortamı Yavaşlat (Async)
solutions.protocol: Canlı yerine yazılı/async ortam seç. Kararı mesaj/yazıya taşı. Kendi temponda cevap.

solutions.name: Ön Hazırlık (S02 ile birleşik)
solutions.protocol: Yüksek baskı anını düşük baskı hazırlığa taşı. Bilgiyi önceden yükle.

solutions.name: UFOV / Speed-of-Processing Training
solutions.evidence: MODERATE — trained task improves, transfer limited
solutions.protocol: 10 seans, 2x/hafta, 5 hafta. Useful Field of View exercises. Be realistic about transfer.

solutions.name: Dikkat Dağıtıcıları Azalt
solutions.protocol: Çoklu görev yapma. Tek odak. Gürültü/kalabalık azalt.

solutions.name: Ekstra Süre İste
solutions.protocol: 'Bana bir saniye ver' de. Out yourself about slow processing. Radically Open DBT technique.

daily_protocol.morning: Bugünkü zaman baskısı anlarını tahmin et + TPM planı
daily_protocol.during_day: TPM 5 adım uygula; async ortamı tercih et
daily_protocol.evening: Hangi anlarda yetişemedin? Hangi ön hazırlık işe yarardı?

weekly: Ortam seçimi: canlı vs async oranı

interactions.note: Hızı artırmaya çalışma; baskıyı azalt ve telafi et.
